definition: a spring flower with a single cup-shaped bloom on a tall stem
hook: The tulip is named after a hat, and it may be because of a misunderstanding.
modernAnchor: A row of bright cups on straight green stems, the first color of spring. We call it a tulip.
journey: Persian dulband was a turban, a long cloth wound around the head. The Ottoman Turks borrowed the word as tulbend.
In the 1550s a European ambassador to the sultan saw a flower he had never seen before and asked what it was called.
The Turks called it lale. But the name he carried home was the word for turban, perhaps because someone was only describing its shape.
Europe kept the mistake. The same Persian word reached English twice, once as turban, and once as the flower that looked like one.
